gist.summary: Added Text Comparison (Comart) to the learn app catalog. The static app uses a single index.html file and has an Arabic right-to-left interface with a client-side Pollinations.ai BYOP OAuth 2.1 PKCE login flow.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art reading nook, Polli wears tiny reading glasses and studies two text panels beside a lime green (#ecf874) retro monitor, with code-plants growing on the desk. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized, never oversized or elongated, and strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with a warm cream and pastel background.
